/api/coupon/redeem accepted 5/5 repeated calls with no anti-automation/rate limit.

/api/me/summary returns a per-identity body under a shared-cache directive (Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=60) with no Vary on the credential (Vary: Accept-Encoding): the authenticated and anon bodies differ, so the response is per-identity; no shared cache sits in front of this origin in the harness, so the leak is proven from the origin's own directives rather than from a captured hit. Any CDN/proxy in front of this origin will store Tenant A's personalized response under the path and replay it to every later visitor.
